bio.es:
Doctor en Tecnologías de la Información y las Comunicaciones por la Universidad de Valladolid (2012, Premio Extraordinario de Doctorado), Ingeniero de Telecomunicación (2008) y graduado en Investigación y Técnicas de Mercado (2010). Ha investigado en CEDETEL, en la Universidad de Valladolid y, como investigador visitante, en el Laboratory for Information & Decision Systems del MIT. Actualmente es Profesor Titular en el grupo BISITE de la Universidad de Salamanca, cofundador y secretario del Instituto AIR y miembro del IBSAL.

Su investigación combina inteligencia artificial explicable, blockchain, IoT y edge computing, y aprendizaje automático cuántico, con aplicación a ciudades inteligentes, sostenibilidad ambiental y salud. Es Editor Jefe de la sección Internet of Things de la revista Smart Cities y editor asociado de IEEE Communications Letters, Sensors y Frontiers in Public Health.

Senior Member del IEEE, preside el Capítulo Conjunto de Communications y Signal Processing de la Sección España y coordina el Grupo Local IEEE Blockchain Spain. Ha sido General Chair del congreso BLOCKCHAIN, Operations Chair de IEEE GLOBECOM 2021 y TPC Chair de IEEE ICUWB 2017.
bio.en:
PhD in Information and Communication Technologies from the University of Valladolid (2012, Extraordinary Doctorate Award), Telecommunication Engineer (2008) and graduate in Marketing Research and Techniques (2010). He has carried out research at CEDETEL, at the University of Valladolid and, as a visiting researcher, at MIT's Laboratory for Information & Decision Systems. He is currently an Associate Professor in the BISITE group at the University of Salamanca, co-founder and secretary of the AIR Institute and a member of IBSAL.

His research brings together explainable artificial intelligence, blockchain, IoT and edge computing, and quantum machine learning, applied to smart cities, environmental sustainability and health. He is Editor-in-Chief of the Internet of Things section of Smart Cities and associate editor of IEEE Communications Letters, Sensors and Frontiers in Public Health.

An IEEE Senior Member, he chairs the Communications and Signal Processing Joint Chapter of the IEEE Spain Section and coordinates the IEEE Blockchain Spain Local Group. He has been General Chair of the BLOCKCHAIN congress, Operations Chair of IEEE GLOBECOM 2021 and TPC Chair of IEEE ICUWB 2017.
